Name: (Portrait) Hiiragiu's Retouched Alex
Author: hiiragiu
Description:
[font=Times New Roman][size=3]I tried to stick to Alex's original look as much as possible, but I also had to alter his face to fit my preferences, hence the few major changes. This mod changes Alex's face shape and hairstyle, as well as smoothens his coloring and a few retouches to his chest & neck.[/size]

[b]Installation Instructions:[/b]

1. Unzip the downloaded .zip file. It contains the mod folder, and you should end up with a folder titled 'Hiiragiu's Retouched Alex.'
2. Move the extracted folder into your Mods folder, inside your Stardew Valley save location.[/font]

[font=Times New Roman][i](Note: This is the first mod I've ever created, and I'm not really used to digital art just yet. I apologize for any errors or issues you may encounter with my mod, please don't hesitate to notify me if you find any! Along with this, I would like to say that I'm open to both criticisms and suggestions, so if you have any, do let me know and I'll try my best :)[/i][/font]
